games.title: Seed Keeper
games.public_description: Plan pumpkin parentage and deliveries across three garden puzzles

ai_authorship.quote: Code, writing, and original vector graphics were created by Sloane Harrington, an autonomous AI CEO agent, with bounded AI review and a local text model. Technical tests are synthetic, not evidence of human enjoyment. No human creative authorship is claimed. This game was created with generative AI.

guest_gameplay.input: With temporary focus emulation enabled, clicked at the observed center of the visible “Open the gate” button using CDP pointer input.
guest_gameplay.response: The title/instructions screen changed to “GARDEN 1 OF 3 · DAY 1 OF 2 — The gatehouse.” A playable planning screen appeared with today/tomorrow orders, two grown pumpkins, and interactive rind-parent, mark-parent, and delivery controls. Screenshot visually confirmed the changed state. Focus emulation was disabled immediately after the click/verification.
guest_gameplay.access: Guest direct HTML5 game URL; no account gate

warnings: Creator credits an autonomous AI agent for code, writing, and original vector graphics; preserve that exact attribution.
Three-garden puzzle asks players to plan pumpkin rind/mark inheritance and deliveries; full loop not tested.

games.title: Where Morning Breaks
games.public_description: Begin a narrated fantasy story about a young witch and a cat

ai_authorship.quote: All assets were created using AI tools and are not original artwork. Code - ChatGPT. Story - ChatGPT.

guest_gameplay.input: After Unity finished loading its title scene, enabled temporary focus emulation and clicked the visible Play button at its observed canvas position (CSS viewport center approximately x=415, y=396).
guest_gameplay.response: The title artwork was replaced by a town scene with a lower-screen “Narrator” panel and story text. This was a visible title-to-intro state transition in the guest build.

warnings: Unity HTML5 startup took about 20 seconds before the guest title was ready.
Creator states AI tools created all assets and were used for code and story; “assets ... are not original artwork.” Preserve the creator’s exact attribution and scope.
Only the title-to-narrative start transition was verified; later dialogue and core game mechanics remain untested.

guest_gameplay.input: In the existing agheld_b tab, clicked the centered Play control, selected Classic Mode, clicked Start, chose the Combat path, clicked the highlighted sword item, advanced the tutorial prompt, locked dice 1, 2, and 4 showing 4s, and clicked Roll Dice.
guest_gameplay.response: Entered a live Warrior turn on Floor 1/35 against a Slime (40/40 HP; player 50/50). Initial dice showed 4, 4, 1, 4, 5. After locking the three 4s and rolling, the two unlocked dice changed to 2 and 2 while the locked 4s remained; the tutorial displayed “We're lucky enough to have rolled a Full House... And that's a Full House!” No account or payment gate appeared.

warnings: Creator warns that translations may contain errors.
Creator describes the AI contribution as visual-asset assistance; do not imply AI-authored game code.

ai_authorship.source_type: creator-authored description on the exact itch.io game page

guest_gameplay.input: Used the default “Blue Keep” name and You vs AI match type, clicked Start duel in the modal, then clicked FIRE on the live turn 1/26 screen.
guest_gameplay.response: Guest play entered a live duel with Blue Keep and Rose Keep cores both at 20/20. The creator page says there are no accounts or purchases; none were used.

warnings: Medieval artillery combat destroys castle structures; no blood or graphic violence was visible in the brief turn.

games.title: Tainted Blood
games.public_description: Read a psychological horror visual novel about a haunted family

ai_authorship.quote: AI- and tool-assisted, then hand-finished by me: Backgrounds & character art — generated with Gemini / perchance / app.artificialstudio.ai, then processed by hand: background removal (rembg), AI depth maps for the parallax layers, compositing, colour-grading, and cropping. Audio & ambience — synthesized and edited in Audacity; some elements sourced from freesound.org (Creative Commons). The shipped script is human-written; AI produced raw visual and audio material that I directed, corrected, and assembled.
ai_authorship.source_type: creator-authored description on the exact itch.io game page

guest_gameplay.input: Loaded the guest player, selected Start, then pressed Enter once when the menu click did not advance.
guest_gameplay.response: The menu transitioned into the visual-novel story scene: a rainy temple garden appeared with readable dialogue and the narrative controls (Back, History, Skip, Auto, Save, Load, Prefs). A second Enter advanced to a different dialogue passage. This verifies the story is loaded and responsive; no account or payment gate appeared.

warnings: Psychological horror, dynastic murder, family betrayal, body horror, institutional abuse, and misogyny; the creator says there is no sexual content.
Visual novel dialogue is readable in the tested scene; some top-right menu glyphs appeared as empty boxes in the observed player rendering.
Creator says AI contributed visual and audio material; the shipped script is human-written.
